recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有三顆小到中型的單核細胞，核圓或卵圓、染色質均勻，淡藍色細胞質邊緣呈毛絨狀、不規則的細突起（hairy projections），與旁邊兩顆分葉核嗜中性球形成對比，符合毛狀細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）。
features: Small to medium-sized mononuclear cells, slightly larger than a mature lymphocyte
Round to oval nuclei with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not appreciable at this magnification
Moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm with ragged, fine circumferential hair-like projections
Scattered mature segmented neutrophils; background red cells with normal size and central pallor, no nucleated red cells
Image resolution limits assessment of nuclear contour detail and cytoplasmic granules
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several atypical mononuclear cells admixed with occasional segmented neutrophils. The atypical cells are small to intermediate in size with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and a moderate rim of pale blue-grey cytoplasm bearing fine, irregular circumferential hair-like projections. No blasts or nucleated red cells are seen in this field; red cells appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells, in keeping with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells usually show a distinct central nucleolus and blastoid chromatin with a high white count and lack CD25, CD123 and BRAF V600E, whereas classic hairy cells have inconspicuous nucleoli.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi concentrated at one or both poles and more condensed chromatin, rather than the circumferential fine projections of hairy cells.
Artifactual cytoplasmic fraying affects cells focally at the thick edge, while hairy cells retain circumferential projections in well-spread areas and are immunophenotypically clonal.
